mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.artifact_repo (repo_id, repo_name, repo_type, description, owner_user_id, visibility, org_id) VALUES ( #{repoId}, #{repoName}, #{repoType}, #{description}, #{ownerUserId}, #{visibility}, #{orgId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.artifact_repo SET repo_name = COALESCE(#{repoName}, repo_name), repo_type = COALESCE(#{repoType}, repo_type), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), owner_user_id = COALESCE(#{ownerUserId}, owner_user_id), visibility = COALESCE(#{visibility}, visibility) WHERE repo_id = #{repoId}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT repo_id, repo_name, repo_type, description, owner_user_id, visibility, created_at, COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(published_at) FROM public.artifact_commit ac WHERE ac.repo_id = artifact_repo.repo_id AND ac.commit_status = 'PUBLISHED'), updated_at ) as updated_at, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.artifact_commit ac WHERE ac.repo_id = artifact_repo.repo_id AND ac.commit_status = 'DRAFT' ) THEN 'draft' ELSE 'published' END as repo_status FROM public.artifact_repo WHERE repo_id = #{repoId}

SELECT repo_id, repo_name, repo_type, description, owner_user_id, visibility, created_at, COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(published_at) FROM public.artifact_commit ac WHERE ac.repo_id = artifact_repo.repo_id AND ac.commit_status = 'PUBLISHED'), updated_at ) as updated_at FROM public.artifact_repo WHERE repo_name = #{repoName}

SELECT repo_id, repo_name, repo_type, description, owner_user_id, visibility, created_at, COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(published_at) FROM public.artifact_commit ac WHERE ac.repo_id = artifact_repo.repo_id AND ac.commit_status = 'PUBLISHED'), updated_at ) as updated_at FROM public.artifact_repo ORDER BY created_at DESC
